# Camp: Weather Control Station - Blooming Haze

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 26, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Apr 11, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_68b10b73fa6e48c593f431116a04f082~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Blooming Haze Weather Station__

Who doesn't love the smell of hazy pollen in the morning?

Weather Control Station will change weather in the C.A.M.P. radius when connected to power.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_98bbc7e6b706428eb3a2892b205356f7~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Hayfever

Jokes it produces a Pollen Haze in your camp radius

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dcd27419fb3c4d6ea04592ca45cf0d01~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ae613bf16c3a4919864c86f8841bfa55~mv2.jpg)

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

All other Weather Control Stations

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Appliances

**Holds**

N/A

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - Weather Control Station (Blooming Haze) - 1400 atoms (TBC)

Atom Shop - Bundle - X atoms

**Produces X amount per**

N/A

**Lockable**

N/A

**Power Required**

2 Power

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
